name: SMR Jewels Ltd
tagline: Rs ~166 Cr just-listed BSE-SME B2B designer / mythology-inspired jewellery supplier -- optically stunning (PAT up ~20x off a tiny base, ROE ~55-72%, ~10x P/E) but a thin-margin, gold-price- and working-capital-exposed job-work model with no listed track record
business_overview: SMR Jewels (BSE SME: SMR) is a Gujarat-based designer of heritage, spiritual, mythology-inspired, bridal and traditional gold / diamond jewellery, sold B2B to wholesalers, retailers, boutiques and jewellery chains across India. It does design and distribution, not consumer retail -- effectively a design-led supplier into the jewellery trade.
fundamentals_table: ~Rs 25 Cr; up ~20x FY23 -> 9M-FY26 off a tiny base
fundamentals_narrative: The headline numbers -- ~20x PAT growth, 55-72% ROE, ~10x P/E -- look extraordinary, and that is exactly the problem for a freshly listed SME: the ROE is on a very thin equity base, the PAT explosion is off a near-zero start, and B2B jewellery is structurally a low-gross-margin, gold-price-linked, working-capital-heavy job-work business with weak switching costs. Conflicting revenue figures across data providers add to the disclosure-quality concern. There is no listed history, no concall cadence, and promoter-run micro-cap governance.
